company_name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited
business_activity: Marine stevedoring and berth terminal operations

evidence.claim: Regulates responsibilities and liabilities of carriers for loading, handling, stowage, carriage, custody, and discharge of containerised goods shipped from Indian ports.
